notes.title: GunQuest Major Update Version 0.2.0.0 - THE BIG ONE
notes.content:
Hey there GunQuesters! Super excited to finally put this update out! I know the wait has been long, but it's finally here!!! Without further ado, here are the changes:


[h1]Major Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Music for Toad Boss!
[*]New Silver Hand Assassin boss fight!
[*]Controller Support!
[*]Save Slot system!
[*]New sound effects for multiple enemies!
[*]Fully overhauled Menu System!
[*]Added Automated Turret: Turret Mk1!
[*]Added Hammer for Turret healing/pointing
[*]Updated bookshelf lore
[*]Added boss shortcuts
[*]Overhauled start menu text boxes
[*]Tutorial Boxes automatically update on Controller<->Mouse & Keyboard
[/list]

[h2]Minor Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Updated interaction prompt based on Controller Type
[*]Added sign for Karthop's Shop
[*]Added controller vibration
[*]Added tile fragments
[*]Removed location text in overworld
[*]Fixed Gate Entry Quest bug
[*]Introduced Automatic Saving
[*]Fixed Gate Guard text coloration bug
[*]Fixed wagon depth in stages
[*]Animated Mayor's House
[*]Generalized NPC code
[*]Fixed melee enemy hitting multiple times
[*]Current Gold now shows in certain dialogues
[*]Generalized saving/loading code
[*]Autosaving for certain levels
[*]General bug fixes
[*]Game Text grammar fixes
[/list]



I'd like to give a genuine thank you to everyone who has been following GunQuest for so long, I'm overwhelmed with the support I receive from the discord, family, friends and anyone else who's willing to listen about how passionate I am for this project. The framework has finally been set. I am very excited to continue developing, and shaping GunQuest going forward along with the community. Cheers!

notes.title: GunQuest Major Update Version 0.0.9.0
notes.content:
Hey all! Restless Gamedev here, bringing in a new update for GunQuest! There's a lot to cover, so let me start with a quick overview of the new features!

[b]Enemies[/b]
There are several new enemy types including, slugs, frogs, and [i]a special enemy only found in the ruins...
[/i]
The new enemies incorporate new movement types and attack patterns which will add new opportunities to try out new strategies to defeat them!

Additionally, the new enemy health bars help in gauging how much damage your character is outputting, and how much health the enemies have left!

[b]Player[/b]
There is a new character swapping system which is quickly turning into my favorite part of the update. It won't be easy, but there is a certain character in the ruined village who is willing to join your adventure, [i]for a price[/i]. 

Once the inclusion of new characters becomes more common practice, there will be a devlog specifically on the creation and implementation of them, however, since this is the first, I am leaving it up to the players to decide on how the character should be played.

[b]Levels[/b]
There is a new subset of levels availible in the ruined village, which include new breakable objects to interact with. Additionally, there is an end fight which is sure to be... haunting :)

There are a few changes to the levels in GunQuest, mainly in design. The original forest levels seemed to be rather spread out and open, which is fine in other games, but for the fast paced action of GunQuest, didn't seem to match properly. Therefore, the levels have been modified to fit the new design philosophy and will continue to change and improve.

[b]Overall Changes[/b]
There is no particular order, since the update was so massive, some elements may have been omitted. If you catch something I left out, please let me know in the GunQuest Discord!

-Fixed melee bug that disabled firing after a few minutes of gameplay
-Fixed old woman character portrait not showing up in certain dialogues
-Corrected ladder code which improperly offset ladder locations upon loading the level
-Increased level creation speed by organizing level building components
-Enemy animations now freeze upon being damaged
-Added in a ceiling tile wall object
-Added animated healthbar to enemies
-New game font!
-Fixed chest drop rates
-Removed deprecated functions
-Optimized larger level performance
-Fixed state bug in toad boss fight
-Fixed numerous spelling errors
-Changed layout for grasslands/overworld stages in general
-Revamped multiple level designs, encouraging speed in combat rather than stagnant battles
-Added Seraphina The Healer to the Tavern
-Added slug enemies
-Added depth dweller
-Added bushes
-Added medallion
-Added Karuna as a playable character
-Added new shop to the ruins area
-Fixed toad boss teleportation glitch
-Added new areas in ruins
-Added Engan the Frontier Warden to the Ruins
-Added character dependent dialogue options

As always, thank you for your continued patience and support. Development has been difficult as of late, given time constraints and outside factors. However, I am dedicated to improving this game, because I love the limitless potential the world, story and characters bring to the table. More than that though, the support I've received from the player base has been awesome, and continues to drive me to improve on the game every opportunity I get. More to come soon.

Thank you all.

notes.title: GunQuest Early Access Release!
notes.content:
GunQuest is officially entering Early Access! As was conveyed in the discord, I was in a low network area for a while, which gave me time to plan and design new ideas for GunQuest. I had a lot of fun creating the new teaser trailer, so be sure to check it out! As for the future of GunQuest, I plan on developing the ruined city, infinite plain, add some more enemies, create a boss battle, and something extra that I'll be asking for input about in the discord server. As always, thank you for your support and see you all next time!

notes.title: GunQuest Update Version 0.0.4.0
notes.content:
[h2]Version 0.0.4.0 Update Log[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42161386/948cdfbf2e234a625f26bde0222122f518117460.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42161386/2a83d7e898c36c77f17147bbf73aa9c60af32091.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42161386/cc88fe514c73d1642a45c29081184bc493a0b5ae.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Added inventory menu!!![/b]
[*] Added 3 new health items: [b]Apple, Bread and Steak[/b]
[*] [b]Health items are now available for purchase and use[/b]
[*] [b]Health is now semi-permanent, as you no longer health between battles[/b]
[*] [b]Health is recoverable by sleeping at the starting house and consuming food, more ways to recover will be added in the future[/b]
[*] Added 3 new types of chests: [b]Common, Uncommon, Rare[/b]
[*] [b]You can now equip the same gun twice[/b] [i](But only if you own two of them!)[/i]
[*] [b]Player now starts with 0 gold[/b] (Was mainly for quick testing purposes)
[*] Added key navigation to starting screen WASD + Space
[*] Fixed text grammar in the Intro Sequence
[*] Fixed error where menus could be opened during room transition
[*] Increased the resources required to create certain guns
[*] Shop items are now sorted by name
[*] Improved start menu logic/GUI
[*] Added sort option to inventory
[*] Randomized the chest item drop amount: # of items dropped per chest
[*] Display health stat during caravan sections
[*] Fixed bug where boost could be activated while on cooldown between rooms
[*] Disabled camera movement during inventory/shop access
[*] Corrected escape reminder logic
[*] Added sounds to more menus
[/list]

A question I've been asking myself recently is, should this game be permadeath? Would that improve player experience? I'm not too sure myself, but if you have any thoughts, head over to the [url=https://discord.gg/gceRtpmJNy]discord[/url]!

[url=https://discord.gg/gceRtpmJNy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42161386/ac0fc441ce8b2291b9836992c4acd2404047beed.jpg[/img][/url]


A ton of the updates here were due to the diligence and feedback from my discord members! 
I wouldn't have been able to do it on my own, so [b]huge thanks to you guys![/b] There are still more updates to come, but I wanted to get this update out there asap because of how impressed I was with the discord feedback! Have a great day!
